name="Layer Description" id="sCskAwCpEVZXoNHZl29_"> <mxGraphModel grid="1" page="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1920" pageHeight="1080" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="d1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;fontSize=20;fontStyle=1;" value="Architecture Description (Vendor Neutral)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="900" x="20" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontStyle=1;" value="Important: External tool data is NOT live-ingested in this demo.
All tool signals are mocked in src/data/mockData.ts and normalized into one bundle for UI rendering + correlation storytelling." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="68" width="1200" x="20" y="65" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" value="L1 - User Access & Authentication
• User opens the public edge URL in browser.
• Hosted login enforces credential-based sign-in before app access." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="96" width="580" x="20" y="155" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;" value="L2 - Edge Security & Session Enforcement
• Edge layer validates auth state on requests.
• Unauthenticated traffic is redirected to login.
• Optional firewall controls can add additional protection." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="600" x="620" y="155" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" value="L3 - Static Hosting Layer
• Static SPA artifacts are stored privately.
• Edge distribution fetches origin objects via restricted origin access." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="88" width="580" x="20" y="275" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d6" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;" value="L4 - Client Application Layer
• React SPA renders all dashboard pages and assistants.
• App state is consumed from a centralized mock-data context." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="88" width="600" x="620" y="275" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d7" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;" value="L5 - Mock Data & Correlation Engine
• createMockData(seed, scenario) generates a coherent data universe.
• Correlation anchors include time window, correlation IDs, service IDs, and incident mappings.
• This ensures all pages narrate the same incident context consistently." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="1200" x="20" y="380" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d8" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;" value="L6 - External Tool Signal Emulation (MOCKED)
• Tool names represented: Datadog, Splunk, Kentik, ServiceNow, Grafana, AppDynamics/Honeycomb.
• Their telemetry/events are currently synthetic and generated in src/data/mockData.ts." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="92" width="1200" x="20" y="510" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d9" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#999999;" value="Future-ready extension
• Replace mock generators with live connectors (API/Webhook/Streaming) from each tool.
• Keep same correlation anchor model so UI pages do not require architectural rewrite." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="84" width="1200" x="20" y="620" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
